fee_notes: Royalty is 6% of Gross Revenue per month; after second year of operations, a minimum royalty of $250 per week applies (converted: ~$1,083/month). Marketing Fee is 2% of Gross Revenue. Local Advertising minimum is $2,000/month beginning the month prior to opening. MarTech Fee is currently $185/month (capped at $500/month), considered part of Local Advertising requirement but collected by Home Office. Membership Marketing minimum $500/month if established (currently no requirements). Membership Perks Program minimum $100/month if established (currently no requirements). Cooperative Advertising minimum $1,500/month when established, satisfies local advertising requirement once salon open at least 12 full months.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee (2): 6% of Gross Revenue per month. After your second year of operations, a minimum Royalty Fee of $250 per week will be applied. Monthly, currently the 8th business day of the month.
Marketing Fee (2): 2% of Gross Revenue. Monthly, currently the 9th business day of the month.
Local Advertising: At least $2,000 per month, beginning with the month prior to opening full term of the agreement. Monthly local advertising requirement must be spent before the end of each month.
MarTech Fee: Currently, $185 per month. Monthly, currently the 8th business day of the month. The MarTech fee is considered a component of the Local Advertising requirement but is collected by the Home Office in conjunction with Marketing Fee. We reserve the right to increase this fee in relationship to direct expenses with 30 days' notice, provided it will not exceed $500 per month.
Membership Marketing: Minimum $500 per month, if established. Paid Monthly as incurred. Currently there are no Membership Marketing requirements.
Membership Perks Program: Minimum $100 per month, if established. Paid Monthly as incurred. Currently there are no Membership Perks Programs requirements.
Cooperative Advertising: At least $1,500 per month, when established. Monthly, currently the 5th of the month.
